title: MIZANE hormones Pixar (legs) – 24 shots for ads X1–X6

shots.h3_prompt: The pink razor glides once across the top skin surface from left to right and cuts the hair tip; the foam stays a thin line on the surface and never drips below it. Below the surface the root character stays fully visible the whole time: it shrugs, smirks at the camera and pushes a fresh new dark hair upward, while the messenger beside it cheers and waves its megaphone. The razor leaves the frame at the top. Static camera. No cut, no scene change. Keep the Pixar-style 3D look; one continuous shot, gentle motion, no morphing. Nobody talks. Clothing, props and labels stay exactly as in the first frame, with no new words, letters, numbers or logos; no text appears anywhere except the real product labels already in the frame. Hands hold only what they hold in the first frame.
